intended_use: First GenoLeWM paper and terminal-demo experiments with reproducible training, evaluation, and release packaging.
leakage_checks: No training split may share comparable variant keys with held-out ClinVar evaluation rows.
Split record counts and comparable-key overlaps are recomputed from staged files before publication.
license: Apache-2.0 for GenoLeWM package metadata; upstream data licenses and terms apply to source records.
limitations: This snapshot is a research artifact for world-model experiments and is not a clinical dataset.
ClinVar labels and gnomAD population frequencies may change after the pinned upstream releases.
Local operators must stage upstream source files under the ignored inputs directory before building the public package.
preprocessing: Stage Carbon source-mix windows from the pinned Hugging Face corpus revision.
Filter local gnomAD VCF rows to PASS SNVs above the configured global allele-frequency threshold.
Normalize local ClinVar VCF rows and preserve labelled and unlabelled SNV classes for evaluation.
